description: Years after the original journey, David's renewed attempts to cure himself intersect with Thor, Daredevil and an espionage plot, bringing the Hulk back for three feature-length final adventures.

s06e01-02.description: David's new gamma transponder may finally cure him, but the arrival of Thor and a criminal attack on the project brings the Hulk back into action.

s06e03-04.description: After David is falsely arrested, blind attorney Matt Murdock reveals himself as Daredevil and joins him against Wilson Fisk's criminal organization.

s06e05-06.description: David secretly works inside a research laboratory seeking a cure until an espionage plot around Dr. Pratt's work forces him into one final conflict.
